title: Charlie Cole Appointed Chief Executive Officer of Lands' End - Global HR News & Updates
description: Lands' End has appointed Charlie Cole as Chief Executive Officer. A seasoned digital commerce and retail executive, he previously led Tribute Technology and FTD and held senior leadership roles at Samsonite and TUMI.

title: Proposed Rules May Expand Access to Fertility Benefits, but Key Questions Remain
description: In May 2026, the Departments of the Treasury, Labor, and Health and Human Services (collectively, the “Departments”) published proposed rules that would establish a new category of “excepted fertility benefits” under federal law.
